title: harness.rule.changed v1
description: An agent-harness rule file changed (a committed edit to a versioned rules tree such as ~/.claude/memory-global). Emitted by that tree's post-commit hook so remediation effect (detector / correction-theme hit rate before vs after) can be measured against a dated, diffable change. Carries identity only — file names, commit SHA and rule ids — NEVER rule content.

tree.description: Logical name of the rules tree, e.g. 'claude-memory-global', 'agent-skills', 'hook-rules'.

commit.description: Commit SHA in the rules tree's repository.

path.description: Path relative to the tree root.

rule_ids.description: Rule ids affected, resolved from the tree's rules.toml (rule id -> files, target detectors, correction themes). Empty when no mapping exists.
